description: This Java source file defines the SearchUpdaterStream class responsible for streaming changes from a cache to the persistence layer of a search index, utilizing Akka Streams and MongoDB reactive streams.

classes.name: SearchUpdaterStream
classes.description: Manages an Akka Stream pipeline to synchronize cache changes to MongoDB, with restart and kill-switch capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a SearchUpdaterStream instance with required configurations and dependencies.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the stream with a kill-switch, enabling controlled termination.

methods.name: createRestartSource
methods.description: Creates a restartable source that emits streams of write models, with backoff strategies.

methods.name: createRestartSink
methods.description: Creates a restartable sink to process batched write models into MongoDB, with backoff and logging.

methods.name: filterMapKeysByBlockedNamespaces
methods.description: Filters entries in a map based on whether their namespace is blocked.

methods.name: blockNamespaceFlow
methods.description: Flow that filters elements based on namespace block status, using asynchronous checks.

methods.name: namespaceOfWriteModel
methods.description: Helper method to extract namespace string from an AbstractWriteModel.
